# Mohamed Amine Gharrab (M.A.G)

> Full-stack developer at SIMTIS in Casablanca, connecting business needs, software engineering and AI.

I build web applications, CRMs and AI solutions around your business needs. I work from analysis through deployment, supporting the teams who use them.

Languages: Arabic, French, English. Based in Casablanca, Morocco.
Contact: contact.maminegh@gmail.com · LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/m-amine-gharrab · GitHub: https://github.com/M-A-Gharr

## Areas of expertise

- [Custom web application development](https://www.maminegh.com/expertise/web-application-development/): Full-stack developer in Casablanca: custom business applications, CRMs and internal tools with API, AI and management system integrations. Tools: React, Node.js, TypeScript, PHP, ASP.NET, C#, PostgreSQL, MySQL, MSSQL, Supabase.
- [AI automation and team training in Morocco](https://www.maminegh.com/expertise/ai-automation/): AI integration, business process automation and custom AI application development, with team training and adoption support in Casablanca. Tools: Claude, OpenAI, Perplexity, FASHN AI, Make.
- [PrestaShop and e-commerce developer in Casablanca](https://www.maminegh.com/expertise/ecommerce-seo/): PrestaShop developer in Casablanca: custom modules, complex migrations, ERP and management software integrations, redesigns and multilingual SEO. Tools: PrestaShop, WordPress, Shopify, PHP, Google Search Console, Google Analytics, Surfer SEO, Semrush.

## Case studies

- [Simtis Studio: AI-generated model shots from a single product photo](https://www.maminegh.com/case-studies/ai-fashion-visuals-studio/): An in-house AI studio that turns a photo of a shawl into model shots, with an approval step, quotas per store and product sheets in three languages.
- [Redesign, multilingual SEO and custom modules for a PrestaShop store](https://www.maminegh.com/case-studies/prestashop-redesign-multilingual-seo/): A three-language PrestaShop redesign: 20+ custom modules, stock connected to the physical stores, and from page 10 to page 1 of Google.
- [An AI prospecting and sales follow-up platform](https://www.maminegh.com/case-studies/b2b-lead-intelligence-platform/): A platform that finds target companies, qualifies them with AI and follows each opportunity to the sale, with a person approving every step.
- [An international website and its B2B CRM](https://www.maminegh.com/case-studies/export-showcase-site-b2b-crm/): A collections website in English, Arabic and Russian, paired with a CRM for prospecting, candidate review and sales follow-up.
- [An industrial website, from catalogue to quote](https://www.maminegh.com/case-studies/industrial-multilingual-showcase/): A WordPress redesign for a nonwoven manufacturer: product ranges, catalogue, customisation and quote requests in French, English and Spanish.
- [Migrating a fashion store from WooCommerce to PrestaShop 9](https://www.maminegh.com/case-studies/migration-woocommerce-prestashop-9/): How I moved a fashion store from WooCommerce to PrestaShop 9 without losing its customers, its order history or its Google rankings.
- [Bakery SaaS: bringing stock, recipes and sales into one application](https://www.maminegh.com/case-studies/bakery-management-saas/): A bakery management application combining stock, recipes, orders and point of sale, with dashboards and an interface in English, French and Arabic.
- [VR Showroom: connecting virtual property visits to sales follow-up](https://www.maminegh.com/case-studies/vr-property-showroom-crm/): A personal real estate project combining interactive plans, 3D models, 360° visits and a CRM with lead scoring, assignment and sales follow-up.
- [Invoice extraction with in-app review and editing](https://www.maminegh.com/case-studies/configurable-invoice-ocr/): Configurable JPG and PDF invoice extraction at OpenView, with in-app editing, human validation and structured JSON or CSV outputs.
- [Medical practice management: records, appointments and invoicing](https://www.maminegh.com/case-studies/medical-practice-management-mvp/): A C# application combining OCR-assisted records, role-based permissions, telephone bookings, insurance deductions and emailed invoices.
- [A reusable application foundation for public share offerings](https://www.maminegh.com/case-studies/banking-agency-java-jee/): A 2020 Java/JEE project at Eurafric Maroc: authentication, an application foundation, client onboarding for public share offerings (OPV) and PDFs.
- [AI documentation for Visualforce](https://www.maminegh.com/case-studies/visualforce-ai-documentation/): A command-line tool that produces structured, customisable Markdown documentation.
- [Claude training: from business tasks to reusable Skills](https://www.maminegh.com/case-studies/claude-team-training/): Claude training built around real tasks, reusable materials and Skills. One Skill tested against 974 historical items, with human decisions retained.
- [Shopify store with cash on delivery](https://www.maminegh.com/case-studies/shopify-home-comfort-store/): A Shopify store, brand identity and an offer with delivery across Morocco and cash on delivery.
- [AI LinkedIn drafts and content calendar](https://www.maminegh.com/case-studies/ai-linkedin-content-planner/): A workspace combining draft generation, multiple formats, favourites and an editorial calendar.

## Experience

- 2026 – Present: Full-Stack Developer & Digital Solutions, SIMTIS · Casablanca. I work across software engineering, AI integration and business digitalisation, designing and delivering solutions used by different teams across the group.
- Oct – Dec 2024: Full-Stack Developer, SaaS Inventory Platform · Casablanca. An inventory, order and sales platform with dashboards and stock alerts, built with React, Node.js and PostgreSQL.
- Aug – Sep 2024: Web Developer, Responsive Business Website · Casablanca. A multilingual business website, designed mobile-first, with analytics and social media connected.
